versions.changelog:
Bullet Journal Generator 1.0.0

- Initial release with full bullet journal generation workflow.
- Converts natural language input into structured bullet journals with task/event/note classification and language refinement.
- Integrates with Obsidian for automatic log creation, with tags, backlinks, and standardized format.
- Supports visual HTML cards (handwritten style) and printable PDF versions of daily notes.
- Includes weather/temperature info and customizable symbol/tag system.
- Provides scripts for input processing, file management, summary generation, statistics, and search.
